questions.q: Why does chaining `.get()` calls work better than chaining `[ ]` lookups on real API data?
options: .get() always returns the full response regardless of the key

questions.q: What does `.get("choices", [{}])[0]` accomplish if choices is missing from the response?

It falls back to a list containing one empty dict, so the [0] right after it doesn't crash
It raises a KeyError immediately
questions.explain: The default [{}] ensures there's always at least one (empty) item to index with [0], preventing a crash.

questions.q: Why do you need json.dumps() when sending a request to most AI APIs?
